name: Buffalo Be Quiet 2024
information:
This competition features "quiet events" and will **NOT** have the standard 3x3x3 Cube as an event. If you are unfamiliar with these events, you may want to consider attending [Niagara Falls Summer 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NiagaraFallsSummer2024) the day after instead.

All competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab.
